TC-16/S19.title: Real dictation on iPhone and Android over two visits, both modes; speaker toggle, STT engine, wrong-date phone
TC-16/S19.detail: Not run. Prior Encounter Transcripts are filled by bedside recordings (Physician / Patient toggle); recording on the emulator needs real speech and the live transcription session (forbidden locally), and a typed encounter does not make transcript lines. The wrong-clock half is covered on the web (TC-16/S18, known B18), and the app writes transcriptDate with the device's date too (TC-25/S24b run: 'Fri Oct 16 2026' from a phone a day ahead).
